detail: The collector binds a Claude Code JSONL only when every sessionId equals --source-id. This in-session agent transcript (isSidechain on all 1,116 bound lines, agentId afe0a9aa3ac64c037, 237 assistant message IDs) carries the parent Code-tab session ID 549ebd43-8839-4e1c-bfd7-1fd0be584ee7, which the Coordinator bound for its own source. Reconciliation groups files by source_namespace and source_id, so a measured file from this child would overlap the Coordinator's range and exclude both. A measured collection under the parent ID validated locally and was withheld from receipt. Whether the parent JSONL also contains these sidechain events was not inspected, because it is another unit's source.
